julia-cs: Heads-up: GreenBridge Health onboarding is degraded for APAC users. They're seeing 429s and connection resets during bulk import. Customer asked for APAC edge failover + temporary QPS lift for the import window. Onboarding date is 2026-05-10 AEST. Renewal conversation is tied to this migration success.

greenbridge-admin: Confirmed. Bulk import from our ETL runs at 03:00 AEST and emits 3k requests over ~10m. We need a 3x QPS bump for 2 hours and an allowlist for our ETL IPs. Also want regional pin to `ap-southeast-2` if possible.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-5147 created for greenbridge onboarding (priority: P1) by julia-cs

tony-net: Need exact IPs and desired TTL for the temporary routes. Are they using a static header we can inspect?

greenbridge-admin: IPs: `198.51.101.12/32`, `198.51.101.13/32`, `203.0.114.0/28`. Header: `X-GB-Import: true`. QPS baseline is 400 -> request 1200 for 2h starting 2026-05-10T17:00:00Z. Auto-revoke at 19:00Z same day.

emily-pm: We're marking the onboarding as "at-risk" until this is done. If migration fails, renewal talks slide and expansion may be delayed. Legal/finance looped.

legal: Please include explicit expiry and customer acknowledgement. We need to avoid permanent config changes without signed amendment.

finance-ops: Note: temporary capacity goes to trial ledger. If they ask to keep it, we'll present dedicated commitment options after migration.

tony-net: Plan: apply ACLs on apac-edge, pin session affinity to ap-southeast-2 for those headers, and lift QPS limiter for the specific trace key. Deploy to staging and then canary for 15m before prod. Rollback: remove config and restore QPS to 400.

tony-net: Proposed config snippet for review:
```
{"customer":"greenbridge","ips":["198.51.101.12/32","198.51.101.13/32","203.0.114.0/28"],"header":"X-GB-Import:true","regions":["ap-southeast-2"],"qps_temp":1200,"expires":"2026-05-10T19:00:00Z","trace_key":"gb_import_20260510"}
```

ops-oncall: Scheduling canary at 16:30Z, prod push at 16:45Z. Resources touched: apac-edge-03, edge-proxy-12, rate-limiter-02. Monitoring hook: https://hooks.redwood/gb-import

julia-cs: Can someone sanity-check with a curl from those IPs after deploy? I'll coordinate customer tests.

ops-oncall: Canary results: 200 responses for import endpoint, p50=140ms, no auth failures. Moving to prod.

julia-cs: Customer ran a sample import now -> most good but seeing sporadic token exhaustion logs on your side. @tony-net can you verify token bucket sizing?

tony-net: Found token_bucket spillover in rate-limiter-02. Bumping bucket capacity for trace key `gb_import_20260510` from 5000 -> 15000 for the 2h window. Also added alert: `token_utilization > 92% -> page ops-oncall`.

ops-oncall: Updated and monitoring. Hook firing threshold set.

greenbridge-admin: Tests passing, full import scheduled for 17:00Z. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

emily-pm: Reminder: schedule a 30-min post-migration retro with CS+Eng to capture feedback and decide on long-term options. Also flag renewal outreach for week after migration.

julia-cs: Noting follow-ups: (1) customer acknowledgement email with expiry/time, (2) legal confirmation in thread, (3) finance to prep pricing options if they request extended capacity.

legal: Acknowledgement template sent to customer; must reply with acceptance.

finance-ops: Preparing draft for dedicated commit options.

ops-oncall: Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-05-10T19:00:00Z. We'll send a 6h and 1h pre-notify to customer contact.

julia-cs: Post-migration update: import finished successfully. No 429s for APAC. p50 latency stayed under 250ms. GreenBridge requests a short enablement walkthrough next week and wants notes on how to avoid future spikes.

emily-pm: Great outcome. Please add onboarding health to the customer record and move renewal from "at-risk" to "on-track" pending final feedback.

julia-cs: Will capture the retro notes and link them to the account. Closing INF-5147 pending signed acknowledgement. Thanks team! :rocket:
